flagged.title: Selecting Timber & Boards for a Purpose
flagged.reason: Regeneration is required because F3 teaches that lamination uses alternating grain, which confuses it with plywood and directly contradicts exam mark schemes.

mark_affecting.quote: Lamination involves gluing thin layers of timber together, but with the grain alternating between each layer.

flagged.title: Joining & Finishing Timber
flagged.reason: The video groups the butt and lap joints under structural frame joints rather than box/carcass joints, which would cause students to lose marks on classification questions.

mark_affecting.quote: Here we've got the butt joint versus the lap or halving joint... stronger for frames.
